reuse.why: Introduces one shared getRangeAmount and makes the existing getScheduledAmount use it, but the five server/shared call sites keep their own number-vs-range dispatch instead of calling getScheduledAmount, which already decides that.

duplication.why: All five copies of the midpoint arithmetic are replaced by one function; the surrounding null/number/range ternaries remain repeated as before.

placement.why: The rule sits in shared/schedules.ts next to getScheduledAmount, where schedule amount logic already lives.

scope.why: Touches only the range-amount sites, their comments and a release note.

maintainability.why: The rule now changes in one place; leftover per-site dispatch is minor noise.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule, shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and schedule-template.ts keep their own typeof-number dispatch instead of calling the existing getScheduledAmount.

one_place.where: getRangeAmount in shared/schedules.ts, used by getScheduledAmount and every server-side ranged-amount site.
